trust: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust

primary_diagnosis.clinical_name: Acute decompensation of chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF - LVEF 32%)
primary_diagnosis.plain_language: Heart failure flare-up (water on the lungs and legs due to weakened heart pump)
primary_diagnosis.verbatim_quote: Acute decompensation of chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF - LVEF 32%)

must_know_medicine_changes.clinical_rationale: DOSE INCREASED from 40 mg daily to 80 mg daily due to ongoing fluid retention
must_know_medicine_changes.verbatim_quote: Furosemide 80 mg oral tablets ... Direction of Change: DOSE INCREASED ... Previous Dose: 40 mg once daily in the morning ... New Discharge Dose: 80 mg (take ONE 80 mg tablet or TWO 40 mg tablets) ONCE daily in the morning

unchanged_medicines.verbatim_quote: Bisoprolol 2.5 mg oral tablets ... Discharge Dose: 2.5 mg ONCE daily in the morning
Ramipril 2.5 mg oral capsules ... Discharge Dose: 2.5 mg ONCE daily in the morning
Atorvastatin 20 mg oral tablets ... Discharge Dose: 20 mg ONCE daily at bedtime (night)

unchanged_medicines.frequency: up to four times daily as required
unchanged_medicines.verbatim_quote: Paracetamol 500 mg oral tablets ... Discharge Dose: 500 mg to 1,000 mg (1 to 2 tablets) up to four times daily AS REQUIRED for pain

red_flag_symptoms.weight_gain_threshold: 2 kg (4.4 lbs) or more over 2 consecutive days
symptoms: Weight gain of 2 kg or more over 2 consecutive days
Worsening shortness of breath on exertion or lying flat (orthopnoea)
Noticeable increase in ankle, leg, or lower abdomen swelling
Persistent dizziness or lightheadedness upon standing
red_flag_symptoms.verbatim_quote: A sudden weight increase of 2 kg (4.4 lbs) or more over 2 consecutive days, or 2.5 kg over one week

who_to_call.primary_urgent_service: St Thomas' Community Heart Failure Nurse Specialist Team
who_to_call.verbatim_quote: PRIMARY URGENT CONTACT (Specialist Team): Service: St Thomas' Community Heart Failure Nurse Specialist Team Direct Telephone Number: 020 7188 5678

follow_up_appointment.location: St Thomas' Hospital, 3rd Floor Lambeth Wing
follow_up_appointment.seen_by: Dr Simon Hughes (Consultant Cardiologist) & Heart Failure Nurse Specialist
follow_up_appointment.patient_action: Bring daily weight log and all current medication boxes

gp_actions.action: Urgent repeat serum U&Es and eGFR blood test within 7 to 10 days (by 14/10/2026)
gp_actions.verbatim_quote: Please arrange repeat serum creatinine, electrolytes (Na+, K+), and eGFR by Wednesday 14/10/2026

carer_counseling.weighing_instructions: Every morning after passing urine, before eating breakfast
carer_counseling.diuretic_timing: Morning (07:00 - 09:00) to prevent nocturia and nighttime fall risk
carer_counseling.otc_warning: NEVER take over-the-counter anti-inflammatory painkillers such as ibuprofen, naproxen, or Nurofen
